verdict.rationale: Floot documents a remote MCP server with a named tool surface (get_logs, query_database, execute_sql, create_checkpoint, generate_image), so an AI client can drive the product programmatically through a first-party interface. It does not appear to offer a conventional public API: probes of every OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no REST or HTTP API reference was found. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP public API with an OpenAPI spec, auth and rate-limit documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Add Floot to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or any client that supports remote MCP servers
query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.
create_checkpoint labels a point you can revert to from the Checkpoint panel in your project view.
